name: Maya Patel
bio: Met freshman year of college. We backpacked through Southeast Asia after graduation and still plan trips together every summer.

name: Carlos Rivera
bio: Former manager who became a close friend. We still meet for coffee every few weeks and he's been a huge career influence on me.

name: Sophie Andersen
bio: We grew up on the same street and went to the same schools for 12 years. Life pulled us to different cities but she still feels like family.

name: James Okonkwo
bio: My roommate for three years in college. We basically raised each other through our early twenties. Now he lives across town and we grab dinner monthly.

name: Leila Nasser
bio: Met through our neighborhood book club two years ago. We ended up having the same taste in everything — books, restaurants, bad reality TV.

name: Tom Bergström
bio: Met at a developer conference in Berlin. We keep up over Slack and occasionally collaborate on side projects. Smart guy with great taste in open source tools.

name: Priya Subramaniam
bio: Study partner through the toughest courses in my degree. She moved to Toronto for grad school and our calls have gotten too infrequent. Need to fix that.

name: Derek Holloway
bio: Met through a mutual friend at a barbecue five years ago and immediately clicked. We play basketball on weekends and he's the person I call when I need honest advice.
